QuestInfo.name: The Reason You Fight
QuestInfo.0: You've told Phantom everything and hope he can help. Speak to him again. \n\r#r(If you fail to complete the quest, forfeit it and click on the sign on the Small Bridge to be moved to Phantom.)#k
QuestInfo.1: Phantom wants to know whether you're fighting for justice or for vengeance. Then, he steals your skills! You prepare to fight him, when he laughs and says he was just playing around. Speak to him again. \n\r#r(If you fail to complete the quest, forfeit it and click on the sign on the Small Bridge to be moved to Phantom.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Phantom wants to know whether you're fighting for justice or for vengeance. Then, he steals your skills! You prepare to fight him, when he laughs and says he was just playing around. \r\nThen he tells you that Seal Stones are useless, so no one around has the power to use them.
